description: Use when the user wants the news-feed view: markets whose probability spiked inside a 2, 12 or 24-hour window, scored by size of move times volume and grouped by event and topic; for a plain 24h ranking by size of move use `top_movers`, and for this feed grouped by category `news_movers_by_category`. The score is `|Δprob_pp| × log10(1+USD-equivalent volume)`. Refreshed after each Polymarket ingest cycle. The `window=` param selects the lookback: 24 (default, ≥15pp), 12 (≥12pp), or 2 (≥2h, ≥10pp); `d_prob` is measured over that window. Includes a `prob_history` array (24h bucketed trajectory) per row regardless of window. `prob`, `prob_history` and `spike.peak_prob` use a 0–100 probability scale. `d_prob` is a signed change in percentage points. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Each market row's `pdata_url` is its event page on pdata.world (null for a market with no event; topic clusters carry none). Filterable by `source=` and `categories=` (CSV). Soft flags (`is_entertainment`/`is_microprediction`/`is_crypto`/`is_sports`/`is_weather`) default OFF; opt in with `include_*=true`. Without a source filter, only venues eligible for cross-venue totals enter the count and ranking. Pass a source to read a venue-only feed.

categories.description: Category filter (CSV). Examples: 'Politics', 'Sports', 'Crypto', 'Weather'. Maps to events.categories assignments.

include_entertainment.description: Include entertainment markets (default: excluded for signal-to-noise).

include_resolved.description: Include markets closed in the last 24 hours with a qualifying pre-close move (default: excluded — news movers focus on live markets).

limit.description: Alias for page_size. Both values must agree.

min_score.description: Minimum spike score. Higher = more notable spikes only.

ordering.description: Sort by USD-equivalent volume (vol, the default), spike score (score), or absolute probability change (d_prob, also called prob or recent).
ordering.title: NewsOrdering

q.description: Full-text search across market title and event title. Case-insensitive substring match.

source.description: Platform ID(s); single value or comma-separated list. Allowed: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion, gemini, hyperliquid, mnx, seer, xo.

name: list_news_movers
